name: combat-fire-creation
description: One shot fired from a boarded craft, captured on the frame it is created. The fire routine copies the player's nine position bytes into the projectile's slot and derives one velocity triple per axis from a mantissa/exponent pair with the direction offset added to the exponent, so this capture is what pins the projectile's speed numerically: read the effect lifecycle at $BDAB, the velocity triples at $BDAB/$BDB3/$BDBB, $BDC3/$BDCB/$BDD3 and $BDDB/$BDE3/$BDEB for slot 8, and the player's own component pairs at $4C/$4D, $36/$37 and $50/$51. The browser cannot express the projectile's motion in its own world units until these are read together.
